entries.summary: Fixed video player by removing authentication requirements. Videos now accessible without login.
entries.details: Changed LessonView to AllowAny for GET requests. Changed VideoStreamView to AllowAny. Removed ProtectedRoute from video player page. Videos can now be accessed without login.
entries.code:
# Changes made:
1. LessonView - AllowAny (GET without auth)
2. VideoStreamView - AllowAny (stream without auth)
3. Route /lessons/:id/video - removed ProtectedRoute

# VideoPlayerPage.jsx
- Full video player with controls
- Chapters sidebar
- Auto-play next segment
- Buffering indicator
